headers.title: Headers and constants
headers.text: The site as Referer on every picture; COVER_ATTR the image attribute that held a real address; IMAGE_BLOCK the class of the post body that holds the pictures.

getPopular.title: Popular (post archive)
getPopular.text: WordPress has no popularity order without a plugin, so Popular is the post archive by date through the REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts) or the HTML /page/N/.

getLatest.title: Latest
getLatest.text: The same archive; newest first is WordPress's own order.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: The post's h1, its featured image from og:image, the first paragraph as description, the author link, categories and tags as genres.

getChapterList.title: Chapters
getChapterList.text: One chapter per post: the post itself, dated from <time datetime>.

getPageList.title: Pages
getPageList.text: The images inside the post body, full size (the -300x200 thumbnail suffix removed), each address once.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One request with the site as Referer; the post lists through the REST API when it answers and through the HTML <article> cards otherwise.
